instructions.admission: Copy admission_decision.template.json to admission_decision.json only after every non-sealed queue entry has been inspected. Sealed final-eval and validation-only rows are never eligible for the training-admitted output, and sealed rows must never appear in semantic_reviews.
instructions.machine_checks: Structural/byte-level checks have already run; see machine_checks on each entry. Sealed final-eval entries retain only structural hashes and decode evidence.
instructions.semantic_review: Only training_candidates and validation_only entries are reviewable. Open image.image_path and compare it with caption; record match/mismatch/unclear in admission_decision.json. The QA script never sets this. Sealed final-eval rows have no caption text and cannot receive a semantic verdict.

provenance.caption_provenance_note: Pinned card declares the raw CC-3M caption as the default answer; the metadata blip_caption field is textually identical for the sampled rows, so per-row caption origin is not distinguishable from the pinned artifacts. Both component terms are recorded.
provenance.sample_order: ascending sha256('<seed>:<upstream_id>') over the first 3000 pinned upstream rows

semantic_review.scope_note: Sealed final-eval rows are structural-only. Their target text is withheld and semantic review is prohibited.
